review: They run big, I had to go half a size down.
Creases on the toe box after one week of wearing them.
The white gets dirty fast but it's easy to clean with a wipe.
Classic clean white look, goes with literally every outfit.
Quite heavy compared with running shoes.
An iconic sneaker, I get compliments every time I wear them.
Leather feels premium and the shoes are very sturdy.
Comfortable for walking around town all day.
Good grip on the sole and the cushioning is decent.
The sole started separating at the heel after a few months.
Took about two weeks to break in before they felt comfortable.
Arrived in the original box and looked exactly like the pictures.
Still looking great after a year of regular wear.
The laces are long and look good.
The tongue is stiff and rubs against my ankle.
Expensive for a shoe that creases so quickly.
